summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. (an Argentine company) announcing the final exercise period for warrants expiring May 11-12, 2026. Each warrant entitles the holder to 1.6367 common shares at an exercise price of USD 0.2641 per share. Holders may also use a cashless net exercise option approved at a shareholders' meeting. The filing is a routine notice of warrant expiration and exercise mechanics; it does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation event.
